slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' AI-assisted 54-country review says DHIS2 functions as Niger's national HMIS for aggregate data, 'likely' from facility paper tallies transcribed at district level; no date is given, so the published date is used.

The review finds no evidence of DHIS2 in routine use at rural health centres and health posts in Niger and scores rural clinics 1, paper at facility level; no figures are given and the date is the published date.

The review says rural health centres and health posts in Niger predominantly record patient data on paper, with no evidence of routine electronic health records at the point of care; the date is the published date.
facts.system: patient records at rural primary clinics (paper)

facts.fact: The review finds no routine electronic health record at rural primary clinics in Niger, digital being confined to aggregation and pilots; no count is given and the date is the published date.
